- **Medial meniscus tear**: Unlikely — no mechanical symptoms (locking, catching, giving-way), no joint-line tenderness *along the medial joint line*, full ROM, no effusion.

- **No labs (CRP, ESR, uric acid) urgently indicated**, given absence of systemic features — may be deferred unless clinical suspicion shifts.

- Reassurance: This is a common, benign, self-limited overuse condition.  
- Emphasize adherence to activity modification — especially avoiding volleyball or similar pivoting sports until pain-free with daily activities.  
- Clarify that oral contraceptives are not contributing to or contraindicating treatment.
